events.title: Abdul El-Sayed Fundraiser with Shigeto, DJ Holographic, Sinistarr, Mike Clark, Bruce Bailey
events.description:
Detroit Music & Community Fundraiser
Supporting Dr. Abdul El-Sayed

Sunday, November 1, 2026 | 3–11 PM
mc3 detroit | 2475 W Grand Blvd, Detroit

An evening bringing Detroit’s music community, artists, local businesses, and friends together for music, connection, and support for Dr. Abdul El-Sayed. Learn about Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, find voter information, and celebrate the creativity of our city.

Music Schedule

3–4 PM: Drummer B
4–5 PM: Mike Clark
5–6 PM: Secrets
6–7 PM: Shigeto
7–8 PM: DJ Holographic
8–9 PM: Bruce Bailey
9–11 PM: B2B Finale Set by Charles Trees, Something Blue & Nick Dagher

Food

Street Beet: Donated catering tray
Eat Street Social: Food truck

Community Contributions

The venue, sound system, and backline are donated. Organizers and staff are volunteering, and artists are donating their time and talent. Artists may also offer merchandise and contribute a portion of their sales to the campaign.

Admission & Donations

A campaign donation is encouraged but not required to attend. All campaign contributions go directly through the official campaign link. Event organizers will not collect or handle campaign funds.
